scope: Read-only interpretation of frozen full native replay evidence; no new application variant, RTL change, test rerun, physical fit or deployment.

same_F23_ELF_hardware_isolation.interpretation: Separating immutable converted output from raw storage removes most of the warm CPU legacy-acquisition wait. The complete frame improves by less than the wait counter reduction because execution and stalls overlap or move.

interpretation: The ownership objective is implemented and functionally validated: output can continue from the immutable snapshot while CPU legacy LOAD/alias work reuses raw storage. This is not an overall throughput win in the measured workload.

Final warm raw-acquisition wait is only 9805 cycles, while admission, topology lookup, full-context/job construction and lease/repair service still add CPU work. The named function buckets identify where to investigate, not individually removable or exclusive cycle budgets.
The warm candidate retires fewer instructions than its control but still takes more elapsed cycles. Instruction-count reduction alone therefore does not establish a speed gain.

The output-full counter overlaps GPU fragment work for 1033860  of 1143120 cycles. It cannot be credited as CPU time recoverable with more queue capacity; the actual full-frame measurement already includes useful overlap.

The first interval retains repair/cold-lookup costs, so the warm near-tie does not establish a positive two-interval result. The tested current implementation remains slower than both its same-ELF control and the prior qualified implementation.

recommendation.physical_fit: Do not run a physical fit or promote/deploy this negative measured candidate. Keep the current production best; component correctness is not the performance gate.
recommendation.next_architecture_hypothesis: If work continues, investigate broader immutable batches that amortize admission, source resolution, context emission and legacy handoffs over multiple compatible vertex/triangle spans, instead of increasing queue capacity again.
recommendation.required_next_measurement: First classify real consecutive compatible spans and their state/fallback boundaries, then prototype the producer/controller with exact same-source-ELF full-frame A/B. Do not subtract current function or wait counters to predict the benefit.
correctness_gates: Preserve original draw/material order and exact clipping/arithmetic fallback.
Bind all geometry and material context immutably until its real consumer completes.
Retain true source-reuse fencing and canonical survivor/fog lifetime across partial G_VTX updates.
Keep raw and output ownership distinct, with reset/cancellation epochs and bounded queue credits.
recommendation.additional_work_this_turn: None: retain frozen evidence and stop app/core variants.

limitations: Measured two bounded native intervals, not sustained Pocket FPS.
Function buckets include gaps preceding retirement; they are not exclusive function execution time.
Do not add these diagnostic buckets or overlapping hardware states to predict savings.
Two prepared GPU-drained game/render/audio intervals with fixed synthetic display/audio arrivals and bounded services, not sustained Pocket FPS or full OS/interrupt qualification.
No FPGA area, timing, placement or physical fit conclusion is made.
